# Sign in with Apple — artwork

Official logo files from **Apple Design Resources** (not custom artwork):

- Source: https://developer.apple.com/design/resources/ → Sign in with Apple Logo  
- Package: `Logo-Sign-in-with-Apple.dmg` (`devimages-cdn.apple.com`)

Used by `AppleSignInButton` on black buttons: `Logo-SIWA-Left-aligned-White-Medium.svg`.

Do not replace these with hand-drawn SVGs. Review Guideline 4 requires Apple Design Resources artwork.
